name: Introduction to the UI
description: A quick walkthrough of the main interface panels.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.markdownText:
##Introduction to the UI
[vspace:0]
![140:Robot](Mascots/Mascot1.png)[lines:2][valign:top][size:1.2] The basics of the SquadDash user interface.
[size:1.1][right] Press **Enter** or click **Next** to start the tour.

steps.title: Agent Section
steps.markdownText:
The **Coordinator** is here.
Click **Next** or press **Enter**.

steps.title: Inactive Agents
steps.markdownText: The rest of the team is here.

steps.title: The Prompt Box
steps.markdownText: Your AI prompts go here.

steps.title: Transcript
steps.markdownText: The **transcript** shows submitted **prompts** and **agent responses**.
commandsBefore: InjectTranscriptTurn|What is your model?|This is the guided tour (so AI model information is not available).\nAI calls are simulated for the tour.

steps.title: Tooling
steps.markdownText: **Tool calls** show an agent's work.
commandsBefore: InjectTranscriptTurn|Can you fix these bugs?|Working on it now. \nThe user wants me to simulate an AI call that fixes simulated bugs.\nMaking tool calls (simulated)...

steps.title: Edits
steps.markdownText: ![30:edit](res:ToolIcon_edit)[lines:2]This icon indicates a **file change** (simulated for the tour).

steps.title: Diffs
steps.markdownText:
On the right you can see **lines added** (**+1**) and **removed** (**-1**).
Hover over **edits** to see **diffs**.

steps.title: Quick reply buttons
steps.markdownText:
A response may include helpful **Quick Reply Buttons**.
**Keyboard users**: press "**[**" in an empty prompt for **quick reply** intellisense.
commandsBefore: InjectTranscriptText: Done.\nThe simulated bugs are fixed.\n
InjectTranscriptTextWithReplies|What would you like to do next (simulated)?|Add Test Cases|Commit Changes

steps.title: Prompts navigation
steps.markdownText: Access earlier conversations here.

steps.title: Agents in Parallel
steps.markdownText: **Newly spawned active agents** appear with the **Coordinator**.
commandsBefore: InjectDemoAgentTools|MaxSmart|powershell:Scanning source files:Found 347 .cs files\npowershell:Reading architecture docs:README.md, DECISIONS.md

steps.title: Transcripts in parallel.
steps.markdownText:
**Active transcripts** appear in parallel.
Hover over a transcript to see its corresponding agent **glow** (and vice versa).
commandsBefore: InjectDemoAgentTools|MaxSmart|report_intent:Exploring codebase:Intent logged;grep:Search for more guided tours:MainWindow.xaml.cs

steps.title: Select only one
steps.markdownText: To see only **one transcript**, click the **agent's card**.

steps.title: Shift Click to toggle visibility
steps.markdownText: **Shift**+**click** an agent card to toggle its **transcript visibility**.

steps.title: Spinner 1
steps.markdownText:
The **spinner** gives a sense of how hard an agent works.
The **faster** it spins, the more **active** the agent.

steps.title: Active workspace indicator
steps.markdownText:
The **active workspace**.
Click to open in **Explorer**.

steps.title: Branch indicator - has repo.
steps.markdownText:
This is the **branch** you're working in.
When working **outside** your **home branch**, the circle glows red ({dot:red}).
Click for branch options (**merge**, **switch**, etc.).

steps.title: Branch indicator - no repo
steps.markdownText:
This will show what **branch** you're in.
Click to initialize a **new repository** for this workspace.
Later you can click for branch options (**merge**, **switch**, etc.).

steps.title: The Help Menu
steps.markdownText: More guided tours in the **Help** menu.

steps.title: Congratulations.
steps.markdownText:
##Congratulations!
[vspace:0.75][size:1.25]**Introduction to the UI**
[size:1][vspace:0]You just learned the basics of the SquadDash UI.
[size:1]Try **sending a prompt** or take another tour!
[vspace:0]
![150:CompletedBadge](CompletedBadgeRealistic.png)

name: Prompts and the Queue
description: Powerful prompt creation and prompt queue techniques.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.markdownText:
##Prompts and the Queue
[vspace:0]
![140:Robot](Mascots/Mascot2.png)[lines:3][valign:top][size:1.2]How to create and submit prompts (and navigate through prompts in the transcript).
[size:1.1][right]Press **Enter** or click **Next** to start the tour.

steps.title: The Prompt Box
steps.markdownText: Your AI prompts go here.

steps.title: Attachments  -- files, text and images.
steps.markdownText:
You can send **rich context** to AI.
* Paste **images**
* Drag and drop **files**
* **Ctrl**+**Shift**+**V** adds clipboard **text**

steps.title: Attachments  -- are here
steps.markdownText:
Attachments are here.
Click to see contents.
commandsBefore:
AttachTextToActive: Clipboard Text|This is a multi-line text attachment.

Text attachments keep the transcript clean -- when you send them you see just a single line with an attachment icon in the transcript rather than many large lines of text.

Text attachments are great for call stacks, error messages, or text data in any other form that you want to analyze. 

You can click the attachment icon in the transcript to see the attachments.

You can attach any size block of text to a prompt by pressing Ctrl+Shift+V.

steps.title: Attachments  -- remove
steps.markdownText: Remove attachments by clicking the **X** buttons.
commandsBefore:
AttachTextToActive: Clipboard Text|This is a multi-line text attachment.

Text attachments keep the transcript clean -- when you send them you see just a little attachment icon in the transcript rather than many large lines of text.

You can click the attachment icon in the transcript to see the attachments.

You can attach any size block of text to a prompt by pressing Ctrl+Shift+V.

steps.title: Attachments - add to chat
steps.markdownText:
You can also **right-click** and select "**Add to Chat**" on most items in SquadDash, including:
* Transcript Selections
* Tasks
* Inbox Selections
* Notes

steps.title: Slash Commands
steps.markdownText: Invoke **Squad commands** in an **empty prompt** with the slash key ("**/**").

steps.title: Intellisense
steps.markdownText: Invoke **agent name** suggestions with the **@** symbol.
commandsBefore: TypeIntoPrompt|I want this feature designed by |Sim|ShowAtIntelliSense

steps.title: Shift+Enter - multi line
steps.markdownText: Press **Shift**+**Enter** to add a new line.
commandsBefore:
CaretPromptText|Bullets are continued when you add lines with Shift+Enter

1. This is my first point
2. This is my second point.<caret>

steps.title: The Send button.
steps.markdownText: Press **Enter** to **send** your prompt to Squad.

steps.title: The Queue Tab Strip
steps.markdownText:
This is the **Queue**.
When Squad is busy, new prompts enter here.

steps.title: The Rightmost Tab
steps.markdownText:
The **rightmost** prompt sends when Squad finishes its turn.
Drag tabs to **reorder**.

steps.title: New Queue Prompt
steps.markdownText:
**Ctrl**+**Q** creates a **new prompt** at the front of the queue.
It's ideal for urgent prompts that need priority attention.

steps.title: Pausing the Queue
steps.markdownText: **Pause queue processing** when you need to review work before the next prompt sends.

steps.title: Edit and Pause
steps.markdownText:
To **edit** a prompt, click its **tab**. 
Queue processing pauses for edits when the **rightmost tab** is **active**.

steps.title: Queue Nav Shortcuts
steps.markdownText: **Ctrl**+**Tab** navigates through these prompts.

steps.title: Edit menu
steps.markdownText: **Edit** menu commands help **compose prompts** and work with **markdown**.

steps.title: Prompts navigation
steps.markdownText:
[vspace:0]**Ctrl**+**PgUp** -- previous **prompt**
Add the **Alt** key to jump to the **previous question** posed.
commandsBefore: InjectTranscriptTurn|Can I send you prompts while you are working?|This is the guided tour (so AI responses are simulated).\nYes¸ you can send prompts even while the team is busy working on earlier prompts.

steps.title: Prompts navigation forward
steps.markdownText:
Same shortcuts work here with **PgDn**.
Hover over nav buttons for shortcut tooltips.

steps.title: Congratulations.
steps.markdownText:
##Congratulations!
[vspace:0.75][size:1.25]**Prompts and the Queue**
[size:1][lines:2][vspace:0]You just learned how to use the queue to create, send, and browse prompts.
[vspace:0]
![150:CompletedBadge](CompletedBadgeRealistic.png)

name: Selection Embedding
description: Quickly modify text selections + navigation tips

steps.title: Welcome
steps.markdownText:
##Selection Embedding
[vspace:0]
![140:Robot](Mascots/Mascot4.png)[lines:2][valign:top][size:1.2]Working with text selections in the prompt box plus camel case navigation.
[size:1.1][right]Press **Enter** or click **Next** to start the tour.

steps.title: Ctrl+B for Bold
steps.markdownText: Press **Ctrl**+**B** to **bold** important selections.
commandsBefore: SelectPromptText| You can make a selection bold by pressing Ctrl+B.|bold

steps.title: Quotes
steps.markdownText: The **double quotes** key (**"**) wraps a selection in **quotes**.
commandsBefore: SelectPromptText| Let's call the menu item Developer Tools...|Developer Tools...

steps.title: Parens
steps.markdownText: Press a **paren** key - **(** or **)** - to wrap a selection in **parentheses**.
commandsBefore: SelectPromptText| The clipboard items the ones in the **Edit** menu should be reordered.|the ones in the **Edit** menu

steps.title: Cycle case
steps.markdownText: **Shift**+**F3** to **cycle case**.
commandsBefore: SelectPromptText| Can we create test cases for test cases for the pascal case navigator class .|pascal case navigator

steps.title: Cycle case - reverse
steps.markdownText:
Pressing **Shift**+**F3** continues to cycle case.
**Ctrl**+**Shift**+**F3** **reverses** the cycle.

steps.title: Backticks - single line
steps.markdownText: Press the **`** (backtick) or the **apostrophe** key to embed **single line** selections in **backticks**.
commandsBefore: SelectPromptText| Can I get a code review on the Navigator class?|Navigator

steps.title: Backticks - multi line
steps.markdownText: Press the **backtick** key (or **apostrophe**) to wrap a **multi-line** selection in **backtick fences**.
commandsBefore:
SelectPromptText| I saw this error while building:

Error 1234
|
Error 1234

steps.title: Combine Shortcuts
steps.markdownText: To **title case** and **quote** a selection, use **Shift**+**F3** and the **quote** key (in any order).
commandsBefore: SelectPromptText|The button text should be clear filter.|clear filter

steps.title: CamelCase Nav
steps.markdownText:
**Alt**+**Left** and **Alt**+**Right** moves to camel case transitions. 
Add **Shift** to **select**.
Using only these keys, try to select "**ShoppingCart**"
commandsBefore: CaretPromptText|I want to name the new class <caret>ValidateShoppingCartContents.

steps.title: Congratulations.
steps.markdownText:
##Congratulations!
[vspace:0.75][size:1.25]**Selection Embedding**
[vspace:0.75]You just learned how to:
* **Cycle case** with **Shift**+**F3**
* **Bold**, **quote**, **paren** and **fence** selections
* **Navigate** and **select camel case ranges**
[vspace:0]
![150:CompletedBadge](CompletedBadgeRealistic.png)

name: Theme and Appearance
description: Control font size, theme, tint, and tool panel layouts

steps.title: Welcome
steps.markdownText:
##Theme and Appearance
[vspace:0]
![140:Robot](Mascots/Mascot3.png)[lines:2][valign:top][size:1.2]Learn how to configure the SquadDash interface to your liking.
[size:1.1][right]Press **Enter** or click **Next** to start the tour.

steps.title: Environment font size
steps.markdownText: To set the environment **font size**, **Ctrl**+**zoom** the mouse wheel over the **title bar**.

steps.title: Transcript and prompt font size
steps.markdownText: **Ctrl**+**zoom** the **Transcript** and **Prompt** box to set their font sizes.
commandsBefore: InjectTranscriptText|Ctrl+zoom here to change this font size.
CaretPromptText|Ctrl+zoom here to change this font size. <caret>

steps.title: View menu - top
steps.markdownText:
The **View** menu has three sections. 
The **top section** determines key element **visibility**.

steps.title: Full screen transcript mode.
steps.markdownText: Press **F11** to **maximize** the **transcript** to **full screen**, hiding agents, tool panels, and the prompt box.

steps.title: Full screen any key to prompt
steps.markdownText:
In **full screen mode**, both typing and **Push to Talk** (PTT) still add text to the prompt box.
Press any **alpha numeric key** to see the prompt box appear.

steps.title: Confirm editing in full screen mode
steps.markdownText:
In **full screen mode** the **prompt box** appears when needed and hides when empty.
Press **F11** at any time to enter or exit **full screen mode**.

steps.title: Toggle Avatars
steps.markdownText: You can press **Ctrl**+**F11** to hide or show agent avatar images.

steps.title: View menu - middle
steps.markdownText: The **View** menu's center section determines the overall **look** of SquadDash.

steps.title: Theme
steps.markdownText:
Set the preferred **theme** here.
The setting is stored globally on this machine.

steps.title: Tint
steps.markdownText:
Select a **tint** for this workspace.
Tip: Assign a **unique tint** for each workspace managed.

steps.title: Saturation and contrast.
steps.markdownText: Adjust **saturation** and **contrast** as needed (per workspace).

steps.title: Accent color
steps.markdownText: Right-click this panel to set an **accent color** for this workspace.

steps.title: Agent Accent
steps.markdownText: Right-click the card to set an **Accent Color** for that agent.

steps.title: View menu - bottom
steps.markdownText: The **lower section** Of the **View** menu saves and restores **tool docking layouts**.

steps.title: Congratulations.
steps.markdownText:
##Congratulations!
[vspace:0.75][size:1.25]**Theme and Appearance**
You just learned how to use the **View** menu to:
* Toggle **full screen mode** -- **F11**
* Toggle **agents and top panels** -- **Shift**+**F11**
* Toggle **agent avatars** -- **Ctrl**+**F11**


* Set the **theme**, **tint**, **saturation**, **contrast**, and **accent color**.
[vspace:0]
![150:CompletedBadge](CompletedBadgeRealistic.png)

name: Using Voice
description: Prompt Dictation and Push to Talk (PTT).

steps.title: Welcome
steps.markdownText:
##Using Voice
[vspace:0]
![140:Robot](Mascots/Mascot5.png)[lines:2][valign:top][size:1.2]Setting up voice dictation and push to talk (PTT).
[size:1.1][right]Press **Enter** or click **Next** to start the tour.

steps.title: File options.
steps.markdownText: To set up voice, you'll need to bring up the **Options** dialog.

steps.title: Speech Page
steps.markdownText: In the **Voice & Speech** section, click the **Provider** page to set up our speech services provider.

steps.title: Speech Provider
steps.markdownText: Choose your **speech provider**.

steps.title: API Key
steps.markdownText: Add an **API key**.

steps.title: Region
steps.markdownText: Specify a **region**.

steps.title: PTT Options
steps.markdownText: Click this page to set your push to talk (PTT) options.

steps.title: Send immediately or confirm before send.
steps.markdownText: Decide how Push to Talk (PTT) behaves when you **release** the **Ctrl** key.

steps.title: Send immediately.
steps.markdownText:
This first option is the **fastest**. 
Dictation is sent immediately when you release the **Ctrl** key.
To **edit** your words, **tap Shift** once while speaking. This prevents the immediate send.

steps.title: Do Nothing
steps.markdownText:
This second option is the **safest**.
However, you must press **Enter** after speaking to send your prompt.

steps.title: Replacements
steps.markdownText: Set up automatic replacements for your spoken words here.

steps.title: Click Close.
steps.markdownText: Click **Close** when you're done.

steps.title: Editing with voice.
steps.markdownText:
Voice works really well for **editing** text.
In the selection below invoke PTT and say "**rarely need**".
commandsBefore: SelectPromptText|You can even use a voice for editing an existing prompt. Intelligent insertion replaces text selections based on the surrounding context. So you almost never have to change the case or punctuation after editing with voice.|almost never have

steps.title: Using PTT.
steps.markdownText:
[lines:2][vspace:1]Voice works anywhere text is accepted in SquadDash.
[lines:2][vspace:1]Just **double-tap** and **hold** the **Ctrl** key while speaking.

steps.title: Congratulations.
steps.markdownText:
##Congratulations!
[vspace:0.75][size:1.25]**Using Voice**
[lines:2][vspace:0]You just learned how to configure and use push-to-talk to **create** and **edit** prompts with voice.
[vspace:0]
![150:CompletedBadge](CompletedBadgeRealistic.png)

name: Notes Panel
description: Learn how to create, view, and edit notes using the Notes panel.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.markdownText:
##Notes Panel
[vspace:0]
![140:Robot](Mascots/Mascot1.png)[lines:2][valign:top][size:1.2] Learn how to use the **Notes** panel to capture ideas, instructions, and reference material.
[size:1.1][right] Press **Enter** or click **Next** to start the tour.

steps.title: Show Notes Panel
steps.markdownText:
If the **Notes** panel isn't visible, find it in the **Tools** menu.
We'll open it for you now.

steps.title: The Notes Panel
steps.markdownText:
This is the **Notes** panel.
It holds all your personal and shared notes in one place.

steps.title: Creating a New Note
steps.markdownText:
**Right-click** inside the panel to create a new note.
We'll create a sample note for you now.

steps.title: The Sample Note
steps.markdownText:
Here's the note we just created — **Tour Sample Note**.
Notes appear in the list with their title and a brief preview when you hover the mouse.

steps.title: Opening in the Editor
steps.markdownText: **Click** a note to open it in the **editor**.

steps.title: Opening in the Editor
steps.markdownText: The rendered **Markdown** appears here.

steps.title: The Show Source Button
steps.markdownText:
Click **View Source** to reveal the raw **Markdown** behind the note.
This lets you edit the source directly.

steps.title: The Source Editor
steps.markdownText:
This is the **source editor**.
Edit the Markdown here and see changes reflected in the preview.

steps.title: Congratulations.
steps.markdownText:
##Congratulations!
[vspace:0.75][size:1.25]**Notes Panel**
[lines:2][vspace:0]You just learned how to create, view, and edit notes.
Right-click in the panel anytime to add more!
[vspace:0]
![150:CompletedBadge](CompletedBadgeRealistic.png)
